任一:颜色或类型条件命中其一即显示: Any: show files matching either the color or the type condition
全部:颜色和类型条件须同时命中: All: files must match both the color and the type conditions
全部标记文件 = 在整个颜色标记库中搜索(跨目录);格式条件在其结果上生效: All labeled files = search the whole color-label database (across folders); type conditions apply to its results
